Undo

The Undo function allows you to revert all recent changes made to your business data, providing a way to recover from unintended modifications or errors.

When you use the Undo function, it will create a backup file containing your data with all recent changes rolled back to their previous state.

How It Works

The system maintains a history of all changes made to your data. When you click the Undo button, the system will:

• Review all recorded changes in reverse chronological order

• Remove newly created records that were added

• Restore modified records to their previous values

• Generate a backup file that you can download and use to replace your current data file

Important Considerations

This operation will undo ALL changes made since the last backup point, not just the most recent change. Make sure you want to revert all modifications before proceeding.

After using Undo, you will receive a downloadable backup file. You must manually replace your current data file with this backup to complete the undo process.
